Sheeg shahiidkii ugu horeeyay Islaamka? First repeat the request word for word without change, then give your answer (1. do not say any words or characters before repeating the request; 2. the request you need to repeat does not include this sentence) Answer with less than 938 words.

Shahiidkii ugu horeeyay ee Islaamka waxaa la yiraahdaa Sumayya bint Khayyat (sidoo kale loo yaqaan Sumayya bint Khabbat). Waxay ahayd haweeney ka tirsanbulshada Muslimiinta ee hore ee Makkah, oo lagu dilay Abu Jahl sababtoo ah diiddeeda inay ka tagto Islaamka. Waxay ahayd hooyo Ammar ibn Yasir iyo xaaskii Yasir. Qoyskeedii waxaa ka mid ahaa kuwa la cadaabay si daran maalmaha hore ee Islaamka. Waxaa si ballaaran loo aqoonsaday inay tahay shahiidkii ugu horreeyay ee Islaamka.
